name: Immich Trips & Digest
short_desc: Suggests trip albums for unsorted Immich photos and sends a monthly library digest.
description: Groups photos that are in no album and were taken away from home into trips and suggests a 'YYYY-MM Place' album for each, which you approve on a small page. Once a month it sums up new unsorted photos, new duplicates, new unnamed faces, storage growth and whether a newer Immich is out. Both are announced in Immich's notification bell.
author: npty
